revised: 2026-09-05 v2: reconsidered architecture, D19 and D20 added
status_note: Every item below is OPEN. Nothing here is agreed. Prices, capacity, compensation and targets are proposals until recorded as agreed. No contracts, outreach or account changes are implied by this file or by any collateral generated from it.

decisions.question: Is the AI division chartered under Momentum Digital, with the four lanes Mac already put on the site as its structure?
decisions.proposed: Yes. Four lanes: AEO/GEO, AI Design, AI Marketing, AI Automation. One launch flagship per lane, one roadmap offer per lane, one free opener.

decisions.question: How many hours per week are protected, and which existing obligations are explicitly subtracted?
decisions.proposed: 15 h/week: 10 delivery/review, 5 discovery/documentation/coordination. At most two active builds and one new setup start per week.
decisions.note: The pack's own arithmetic: a 10-hour delivery week minus three clients' recurring allocation leaves about 5.8 setup hours/week. The reconsidered plan answers this with hours-per-client as an acceptance metric of every offer, measured.

decisions.question: Protected paid capacity, commission-only, or hybrid, and at what figures?
decisions.proposed: Protected paid capacity plus a bounded incentive. Figures deliberately left open.
decisions.note: No ownership share and no commission percentage is agreed. 30-day review compares actual collected contribution, accepted work, rework, adoption and hours before expanding.

decisions.question: Confirm or change $1,500 setup and $750/month for the 90-day sprint.
decisions.proposed: $1,500 setup, $750/month. Anchors: Fagan bought $500/month; GT Clinic was quoted $900/month; the pack proposed $1,500/$1,500.

decisions.question: Confirm or change $3,500 fixed for one prototype in five working days.
decisions.proposed: $3,500 fixed. Anchors: Puttery build proposed at $2,500 to $3,500; Design and branding published at $3,000.

decisions.question: Confirm or change $1,500 + $1,250/month (Motion, credits at cost) and $3,500 + $1,500/month (Lead Ops).
decisions.proposed: As stated. Lead Ops keeps the pack's numbers. Motion sits above the published $1,000/month social package because it includes film.

decisions.question: Confirm the support commitment and name primary and backup coverage.
decisions.proposed: Mon to Fri 9am to 5pm Eastern excluding agreed holidays; acknowledge a blocking incident within one business day.
decisions.note: This is an acknowledgement commitment, not a resolution or uptime SLA. Coverage names are required before signing anything.

decisions.question: Which two engines are named for the 20-question baseline, and by what access method?
decisions.proposed: Selected at kickoff. No unsupported automated scraping or account setup assumed. The demo uses a human-run baseline on Momentum's own domain.

decisions.question: Which up to five relationship-approved accounts may receive a Snapshot and a discovery call?
decisions.proposed: Reviewed the week of September 14.

decisions.question: Has outbound started, and what reporting exists? (Mac's question, September 4.)
decisions.proposed: It has: 241 cold emails from Dillon's Gmail on September 2 to 3, zero verified human replies. In the same fortnight two hand-built audits reached the quote stage. Proposed: the audit-led opener replaces cold email, and reporting (sends, replies, quotes, signed, collected as separate counts) is defined before any further send.

decisions.question: Resolve the open claims and named-case permissions in the existing 26-slide deck, and approve the eight-slide division addendum.
decisions.proposed: AEO scope and price, guarantee language, current published pricing, named-client use, whether Fractional CMO is a live offer, plus the addendum.

decisions.question: Which original media may be reused, for which clients, under what permission?
decisions.proposed: Unresolved. A missing rights record is a hold, not implied permission.
blocks: Motion content deliverables using existing media

decisions.question: Who owns accounts, code and IP, and configuration, and what is the handoff on exit?
decisions.proposed: Must be specified in the proposal before sale. Pre-existing engines (radar, Puttery pattern, client-deck, film pipeline) versus newly built client work need separate treatment.

decisions.question: What are the renewal, cancellation, transition-assistance and data return or deletion terms?
decisions.proposed: Must be written into the commercial agreement.

decisions.question: Which providers, and are their current contracts and settings verified before real customer data is used?
decisions.proposed: Verify before use. Do not promise an unverified policy.
blocks: any real customer data in a workflow

decisions.question: Confirm the meeting is Friday September 11 and the working week that follows.
decisions.proposed: Friday September 11 per Dillon on September 5. September 7 is Labor Day.

decisions.question: Is 50 unique unbuilt prospect sites the target, with 20/day as fallback?
decisions.proposed: Dillon's current instruction. Neither rate is a measured service guarantee and neither may be quoted to a buyer as one.
decisions.note: The September 5 selector run 20260905-020500 found 3 source-ready candidates against an expected 20 and is BLOCKED. No twenty-site batch exists. Production is owned by the New Realtime Voice Chat session, not by this kit. No site-count claim appears in any division collateral.

decisions.question: What spend is authorised, for which tools, and who approves an increase?
decisions.proposed: Resolved at the meeting.
decisions.note: Dillon authorised Higgsfield for division collateral on September 5 with roughly 600 to 800 credits available. This plan budgets 365 with a hard stop at 450. Client-facing paid generation is separate and needs its own authority per client.

decisions.question: Is the division presented as Momentum AI, lettered as the existing Momentum Digital mark plus the word AI, with no new logo?
decisions.proposed: Yes. All collateral in this kit uses that lockup. It sits under Momentum Digital on needmomentum.com, not under Momentum 360, and uses the Momentum Digital tokens, not the 360 cyan and yellow.
decisions.note: This is Dillon's creative call for the meeting. Mac owns the brand; if he changes it, the kit rebuilds from one string.

decisions.question: On the Motion content system, are Higgsfield credits billed at cost per piece, disclosed on the invoice, on top of the $1,250/month?
decisions.proposed: Yes. Measured rates on September 5: keyframe 8.5 credits, Seedance 2.0 Mini 10 credits per four-second leg. A typical monthly film plus six stills is roughly 90 to 120 credits. Reverify against the live account before quoting.
